scope: Bounded public standalone KV metadata list filtering, cursor navigation and selected-form state wiring source review
decision: Retain source unchanged; no concrete supported correction selected
selectedSemantics: Mount and path searches filter only current query items case-insensitively; shared metadata table copies/sorts and limits rendered rows to100, with explicit ID tie break. No server-side search or all-pages result claim.

Collection URLs preserve explicit mountId and encode opaque final cursors. Previous removes one cursor; Next appends supplied nextCursor. Both cursor moves clear corresponding local search. Controls are outside filtered rows so an empty result page with nextCursor can advance.

Browse mount resets path cursor history, selected detail and path search. Show all clears mountId/path cursor history/selection, while preserving current path search. Plain page/search changes retain selected detail and captured metadata forms.

Mount forms require fresh canWrite effective administrator; registration uses fresh canKvWrite preserving scoped writers. Opening existing forms requires fresh mount-list metadata, with explicit captured mount/namespace/field-key mappings. No new preflight or draft-reset model.

usable suppresses retained metadata on401/403 and otherwise retains current query data. Cursor movement disabled on refreshing/error. When an unsuccessful page has no data, its table/pager branch is absent and Retry remains.

Explicit row action selects PathDetail byID independently of filtered rows; close clears selection and returns focus to connected row trigger or path search. No deep workbench, private action, value, version, recovery or backend trace.
limitations: No current React/browser/keyboard/AT/backend acceptance; source/read-only saved public evidence only. Previous build/CI remains historical.

No universal clear-on-page/search behavior, uniform pager availability on initial errors, capped standalone cursor history, or independent form authorization preflight is established. No new requirement inferred.
